cli.currency_help: Ikhowudi yemali, oonobumba okanye amanani ayi-2-16 (okungagqibekanga: {default})
cli.epilog:
Imizekelo:
  %(prog)s
    Jonga ixabiso le-Bitcoin ngaphandle kwemida (amaxabiso asebenzayo abuyisela OK)

  %(prog)s -w 30000:50000 -c 25000:60000
    Isilumkiso ukuba ixabiso lingaphantsi kwe-30000 okanye lingaphezu kwe-50000
    Imeko ebucayi ukuba ixabiso lingaphantsi kwe-25000 okanye lingaphezu kwe-60000

  %(prog)s --warning-low 30000 --critical-low 25000
    Lumkisa kuphela xa ixabiso lihla

  %(prog)s --currency eur
    Jonga ixabiso nge-EUR endaweni ye-USD
cli.max_age_help: Ubude bexesha obuphezulu bexabiso ngemizuzwana; kufuneka uphawu lwexesha lomthengisi (okungagqibekanga: {default} xa ixabiso linophawu lwexesha)
